Indicator: Summary of the content moderation engaged in at the providers’ own initiative
Value:
Before content is published on the platform, Hostelworld utilizes automated filtering technology designed to intercept potentially harmful material.
Keyword Filtering: Our systems utilize a comprehensive database of prohibited keywords and phrases.
Objective: These filters are specifically configured to restrict the upload of content that is identified as illegal or in breach of the Hostelworld Terms and Conditions.
Effect: Content flagged by these automated tools is prevented from being posted, acting as a primary layer of defense against non-compliant material.
While automated tools provide the first line of defense, all nuanced content moderation is governed by human intervention.
The Hostelworld dedicated Customer Services Team holds the primary responsibility for moderation activities.
Notice and Action: Beyond proactive filtering, the team investigates 100% of the notices received.
Scope of Action: The team is authorized to take necessary measures under the DSA, including the removal of content, the suspension of accounts, or the restriction of visibility for content that violates legal or platform standards.

Indicator: Meaningful and comprehensible information regarding content moderation engaged in at the providers' own initiative
Value:
To ensure a trustworthy marketplace, our platform engages in targeted content moderation at our own initiative. This proactive oversight is limited specifically to the authenticity of property reviews to protect users from deceptive or fraudulent information.
Our internal moderation efforts are focused solely on identifying and removing reviews that do not represent a genuine consumer experience. This includes:
Fake Reviews: Content generated by bots, paid services, or the property owners themselves.
Conflict of Interest: Reviews posted by individuals with a financial stake in the property or a direct competitive relationship.
Incentivized Content: Reviews submitted in exchange for undisclosed compensation or prohibited discounts.  Flagged content is reviewed by our Customer Service team before any removal action is taken.

Indicator: Qualitative description of the automated means
Value:
Hostelworld employs a Rules-Based Automated Filtering System designed to prevent the publication of prohibited content at the point of entry. This system serves as a first-line preventative measure to ensure platform integrity and user safety.
Functional Logic and Methodology
The automated means consist of a Keyword-Based Blocklist API integrated into the content submission interface.
Mechanism: The system scans user-generated text in real-time against a predefined library of prohibited terms, phrases, and patterns.
Execution: If a match is detected, the system triggers a hard-stop mechanism that prevents the content from being uploaded to the platform.
Scope: These keywords are primarily targeted at identifying:
Severe profanity or hate speech, and the sale of illegal products such as drugs.
Human Oversight and Error Rates
While the initial filter is automated, the underlying keyword library is manually curated and periodically reviewed by our Customer Service team to minimize "false positives" (the accidental blocking of legitimate speech).
